subject: HarborBank: Exec intro + demo — CIO conflict, propose split coverage

Subject: HarborBank pilot demo — exec intro and VP/CIO presence

Hi Emma — great to connect last week.

Per our conversation we suggested including a short exec intro with Michael (CIO) and a 45-minute product walkthrough for the payments team. To make this high-signal for your execs, attached is a two-slide agenda and a lightweight list of tailored questions (harbor_mvp_agenda.pdf).

Quick asks:
- Would Michael be available for a 15-minute intro immediately before the demo on Tue 9/16 at 10:15 PT?
- If he's constrained, is Emma (VP Eng) able to open with a 5–10 minute context-setting intro and we’ll record the CIO brief for later distribution?

We can also split the session: 10:00–10:20 technical deep-dive with your engineers, 10:20–10:35 exec intro + Q&A. That keeps the CIO time short while ensuring technical coverage.

I’ll hold a provisional 10–11am PT slot and attach a short security checklist (security_qs_dataset.xlsx) that Michael might ask for.

Thanks — I’ll await what works and can loop in Ben (solutions lead) or Laura (AM) for backup.

Best,
David Kim
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Hi David — thanks for sending. Agenda looks useful. Quick update on execs: Michael (CIO) is traveling and only has a 20-minute window mid-week (Wed morning) but he prefers synchronous if possible — he doesn't want a recorded-only brief.

Reality check: our payments squad prefers Tue 9/16 at 10am PT for the deep-dive. Can you do this:
- Tue 9/16 10:00–10:30 PT — product deep-dive with engineers (we need Ben or your lead engineer present)
- Wed 9/17 09:30–09:50 PT — 20-minute live CTO/CIO executive intro (Michael) + Q&A (we can keep it tight)

If you can’t do a split, the fallback is VP Eng (me) opens Tue for 10 minutes and Michael joins recorded + live 10-minute follow-up later.

Also, please send any procurement or SOW checklist that Michael will want ahead of Wed — we’re trying to surface red flags early.

-Emma
